name: Radu Stoian MCP Server & Agent Tools
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing dynamic question answering, section retrieval, and external investigation links grounded in the site's knowledge base, plus client-side WebMCP tools.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Answers generic or specific questions about Radu Stoian using a dynamic retrieval engine that grounds its answers by pulling from the site's knowledge base, along with external investigation links.

query.description: The natural language question to ask about Radu Stoian

tools.name: get-section
tools.description: Returns the complete text of a specific section from the site's knowledge base (e.g. 'Projects, Clients and Case Studies', 'Skills and Certifications', 'Areas of Expertise', 'Client Testimonials', 'Publications and Insights', 'Speaking and Industry Engagement').

section.description: Name or keyword of the section to retrieve. Valid canonical sections: 'About Radu Stoian (#about)', 'Profile Breakdown (#about)', 'Areas of Expertise (#expertise)', 'Client Testimonials (#testimonials)', 'Additional Skill Details and Recommendations (#testimonials)', 'Main Profile Links (#connect)', 'Public Profiles (#connect)', 'Contact and Connect (#connect)', 'Publications and Insights (#insights)', 'Projects, Clients and Case Studies (#projects)', 'Speaking and Industry Engagement (#speaking)', 'Skills and Certifications (#skills)', 'Agentic AI Discovery & Infrastructure', 'Layer 3: The Discovery & Signalling Layer (#layer-3)', 'Layer 2: The Documentation Layer (#layer-2)', 'Layer 1: The Technical Infrastructure & Execution Routes (#layer-1)'. Common aliases such as 'Career History', 'Projects and Clients', 'Expertise', 'Talks', or 'Education' are also supported.

tools.name: get-investigation-links
tools.description: Returns external links and public profiles for AI agents to investigate Radu Stoian (LinkedIn, GitHub, Substack, SpeakerDeck, Credly, Google Skills, etc.).

tools.name: server-info
tools.description: Returns information about this MCP server, runtime environment, and available data sources.
